import numpy as np

# Load data from attached file
spec = files[0]["table"]
x = spec["raman_shift_cm-1"]
y = spec["intensity"]

# Normalize to [0, 1]
y_min = np.min(y)
y_max = np.max(y)
y_norm = (y - y_min) / (y_max - y_min)

# Save the result
path = save_result("T042_normalized", y_norm, raman_shift=x)

print(f"Normalization complete.")
print(f"Original range: [{y_min:.4f}, {y_max:.4f}]")
print(f"New range: [{np.min(y_norm):.4f}, {np.max(y_norm):.4f}]")
print(f"Saved to: {path}")
